title: First videotaped Grusch interview at Bryce's house

tellings.quote: So he came over and we, you know, Dave Crush was in, you know, cargo shorts and a t-shirt for this thing.

plain: In 2023 the first filmed interview with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public with claims about secret UFO programmes, was recorded at a house in Los Angeles, says Bryce Zabel, a Hollywood writer and producer who says it was his house and he was there. Zabel tells Michels that Grusch turned up "in cargo shorts and a t-shirt," and he names the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart and a man called Jared among the people involved. He tells it as an inside look at how one of the best-known UFO whistleblowers first went on camera.
